div.div: What you no longer run yourself: controller lifecycle, patching, scaling and upgrades. No provider pods, no XRD/Composition operators competing for your worker nodes, and no transit gateway or VPC peering just to reach clusters in other accounts and Regions.

div.div:
1 platform team publishes RGDs, the reusable building blocks 2 Argo CD syncs desired state from Git 3 developer commits an app plus a kro instance, a small purpose-built API call
4 Argo CD deploys to every target account with no VPC peering or transit gateway 5 kro expands the instance and ACK creates and reconciles the AWS resources
Short dash optional distribution of RGDs as OCI artifacts through Amazon ECR
